info.title: SDKWork Shop Merchandise Backend API Module
info.description: Merchandise capability routes aggregated by the SDKWork Shop backend authority.
info.x-sdkwork-audience: Backend consoles, operators, control-plane integrations, and admin automation.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale the text fields are rendered in. A missing translation falls back to the base row (the seed manifest's fallbackLocale rule).

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The row version this request is editing, taken from the `version` field or the `ETag` of the last read. Required: `API_SPEC` section 2189 maps a missing required precondition to `42801 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED`. The bare form `3` is accepted alongside the standard quoted entity-tag `"3"`; the weak form `W/"3"` and the wildcard `*` are both refused, because `If-Match` compares with the strong comparison function and `*` would let a caller opt out of a precondition this operation declares as required.

ETag.description: The row version this representation was read at, quoted as a strong entity-tag. Send it back verbatim as `If-Match` on the next write; it is the same number the body's `version` field carries, emitted as a header so a client can round-trip it without parsing the payload.

412.description: Precondition failed. `If-Match` named a version the row no longer carries, so nothing was written; the problem detail names both the expected and the current version. Distinct from `409`, which is a domain state conflict rather than a stale copy.

428.description: Precondition required. This operation edits an existing row and `If-Match` was not sent, so the server cannot tell which version the caller read.

categoryNo.description: Stable business key of the category, unique per tenant while the row is live (uk_commerce_product_category_tenant_no).

parentId.description: Parent category id. Omit for a root category.

name.description: Default-locale display name. Bound by ck_commerce_product_category_name_length (1..200).

sortOrder.description: Ordering rank among the siblings. Defaults to 0.

backParentId.description: The back-office tree position, when the category sits on one. The two trees are independent.

locale.description: The locale the text fields are written in. Omitted — or the default language — writes the base row; any other locale writes a translation row and leaves the base row alone.

parentId.description: New parent. Omit to leave the parent unchanged.

name.description: New default-locale name. Bound by ck_commerce_product_category_name_length (1..200).

status.description: Lifecycle status. ck_commerce_product_category_status admits 'active' and 'inactive' only; retirement is a DELETE, never a status.

backParentId.description: Three-state. Absent keeps the stored back-office position; an explicit null removes the category from the back-office tree; an id moves it.

locale.description: The locale the text fields are written in. Omitted — or the default language — writes the base row; any other locale writes a translation row and leaves the base row alone.

productNo.description: Stable business key of the product, unique per tenant while the row is live (uk_commerce_product_spu_tenant_no).

title.description: Default-locale display title. commerce_product_spu.name is derived from it and bound by ck_commerce_product_spu_name_length (1..300).

productType.description: How the product is delivered in the large. ck_commerce_product_spu_product_type is the authority for this set.

categoryId.description: Category the product belongs to. Required: commerce_product_spu.category_id is NOT NULL.

modelNo.description: The manufacturer's standard model number, when one is declared.

barcode.description: The product-level barcode (GTIN/EAN), unique per tenant while the row is live.

weightGram.description: Ship weight in grams, the figure logistics rates a shipment from.

taxClassCode.description: The tenant's tax-classification key for this product.

brandId.description: The brand this product belongs to, when one is declared.

locale.description: The locale the text fields are written in. Omitted — or the default language — writes the base row; any other locale writes a translation row and leaves the base row alone.

CreateProductRequest.description: The fixed-semantics fields (model number, barcode, weight, volume, tax class) are columns, not dynamic attributes, so they are queryable and constrainable — the baseline's own comment on commerce_product_spu.

title.description: New default-locale title. Bound by ck_commerce_product_spu_name_length (1..300) through the derived name.

description.description: New default-locale description. Three-state on purpose: omitting the field leaves the stored text unchanged, an explicit `null` clears it, and a value replaces it. Clearing is stated rather than inferred because description is a nullable column — NULL is how a product is stored with no description, so an absent key must not be read as a request to remove one.

categoryId.description: Move the product to another category.

status.description: Lifecycle status. ck_commerce_product_spu_status admits these four, and salesStatus is derived from the value on every write. draft is a state to leave, not one to return to: ck_commerce_product_spu_published_at refuses status=draft once publishedAt is recorded, because publishing is a one-way transition. Retirement is a DELETE.

modelNo.description: Three-state. Absent leaves the stored model number alone; an explicit null removes it; a string replaces it.

barcode.description: Three-state. A restated barcode must be unique per tenant (uk_commerce_product_spu_tenant_barcode).

weightGram.description: Three-state. ck_commerce_product_spu_weight pins a restated value >= 0.

volumeMl.description: Three-state. ck_commerce_product_spu_volume pins a restated value >= 0.

brandId.description: Three-state. Absent keeps the stored brand; an explicit null detaches the product from its brand; an id moves it.

locale.description: The locale the text fields are written in. Omitted — or the default language — writes the base row; any other locale writes a translation row and leaves the base row alone.

skuNo.description: Stable business key of the SKU, unique per tenant while the row is live (uk_commerce_product_sku_tenant_no).

salePriceMinor.description: Price actually charged, in the currency's minor unit (fen for CNY, yen for JPY). API_SPEC section 13.2.1 fixes the wire unit at the minor unit, so 640 means 640 fen and no layer rescales it.

listPriceMinor.description: Optional reference price in the same minor unit, used for the strike-through figure. It is never below salePriceMinor (ck_commerce_product_sku_sale_not_above_list); omit it rather than sending 0 to mean "not declared".

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency every amount in this request is stated in. Bound by ck_commerce_currency_code_shape and by the foreign key to commerce_currency.

fulfillmentType.description: How one unit of this SKU reaches the buyer. ck_commerce_product_sku_fulfillment_type is the authority for this set.

version.description: The product row's version after the replacement. The set is part of the product aggregate, so this is the number the next If-Match on the product (or on this set) must name; it is the same value the response's ETag carries.

ProductAttributes.description: The product's whole key/parameter attribute set as stored after a replacement. This is the specification table a product detail page renders; replace it wholesale with PUT on the sub-collection.

listId.description: The price list this row prices into.

currencyCode.description: Inherited from the list; the composite foreign key refuses an item quoting money its list does not deal in.

minorUnitExponent.description: A unit exponent, not an amount: the list's price scale the minor-unit amounts are stated against.

priceMinor.description: The price at this ladder step, in the currency's minor unit. ck_commerce_price_list_item_price keeps it non-negative. API_SPEC section 13.2.1 fixes the wire unit at the minor unit.

minQuantity.description: The quantity this step starts at; 1 is the first rung of the ladder (ck_commerce_price_list_item_min_quantity).

status.description: Shared lifecycle status; ck_commerce_price_list_item_status admits these two.

version.description: Monotonic row version, bumped by every write. Echo it back as `If-Match` on the next update or delete.

skuId.description: SKU the step prices. Must name a live SKU of the tenant.

listId.description: The list to price into. The currency and scale are inherited from it.

priceMinor.description: The price at this step, in the list's minor unit. API_SPEC section 13.2.1 fixes the wire unit at the minor unit.

minQuantity.description: The quantity this step starts at. Defaults to 1, the first rung of the ladder.

priceMinor.description: New price at this step. API_SPEC section 13.2.1 fixes the wire unit at the minor unit.

minQuantity.description: New tier start. Restating it onto a step another row of the same list already prices is a `409`, not a silent merge.

status.description: Shared lifecycle status.

tenantId.description: The tenant the brand belongs to. Always the caller's own scope.

organizationId.description: The organization the brand belongs to. Always the caller's own scope.

brandNo.description: Stable business key of the brand, unique per tenant while the row is live (uk_commerce_product_brand_tenant_no).

name.description: Default-locale display name. Bounded by ck_commerce_product_brand_name_length (1..200).

status.description: Shared lifecycle vocabulary. The authority for this set is ck_commerce_product_brand_status.

version.description: Row version, advanced by every write to this row and by any write that retires it. Echo it back as `If-Match`.

brandNo.description: Stable business key of the brand, unique per tenant while the row is live.

name.description: Default-locale display name. Bound by ck_commerce_product_brand_name_length (1..200).

sortOrder.description: Sibling ordering key, ascending. Defaults to 0.

locale.description: The locale the text fields are written in. Omitted — or the default language — writes the base row; any other locale writes a translation row and leaves the base row alone.

name.description: Replacement display name. Bound by ck_commerce_product_brand_name_length (1..200).

description.description: Three-state. Absent leaves the stored text alone; an explicit null removes it; a string replaces it.

status.description: Shared lifecycle vocabulary. The authority for this set is ck_commerce_product_brand_status.

locale.description: The locale the text fields are written in. Omitted — or the default language — writes the base row; any other locale writes a translation row and leaves the base row alone.

AuthToken.description: SDKWork auth token carried as Authorization: Bearer <auth_token>.
